source.title: Official American Thoracic Society/Japanese Respiratory Society clinical practice guidelines: lymphangioleiomyomatosis diagnosis and management.

whyItFits: Full ATS/JRS LAM guideline text posted by the American Thoracic Society, including the sirolimus, VEGF-D, doxycycline, and hormonal-therapy recommendations.
limitations: Full guideline text from the ATS PDF. Replaces the PMC abstract. Doses that are not in the recommendation sentences used here are not taught.
